dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a slight concave curvature (falcate) from the posterior insertion to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin contour at approximately 70 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.0 base width to 1.2 vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, uniform convex arc forming the anterior-dorsal boundary of the cranium.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and thick pixel profile extending from the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the transition point between the melon slope and the rostrum.
